recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one missed-completion check hosted on the Synology: nightly-sync records each successful finish there, and the Synology emails the user if that signal hasn't arrived by the expected finish time plus a buffer.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to hear when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving everything into Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own email, so an early crash also kills the notification.
labels.Checked myself: Only your supplied facts: four startup failures, no alert, and an available Synology.

note: It is a single alert, but it is a check the user would build and host on the Synology rather than a hosted heartbeat or an existing mechanism, so it falls under the self-hosted-service case and counts as LARGER.
